source: Bosch DIY product page (fluted beech dowels); Ostermann REDOCOL fluted dowel datasheet to DIN 68150
about: Wooden dowels for joining sheet goods. Sizes only; no published joint strength exists from these sources.

body.name: dowel_beech_fluted_bosch_6x30

body.notes: Fluted beechwood dowel, pack of 50. No standard is cited by the supplier. No joint strength is published for dowel joints in birch plywood: treat as an open question until tested or calculated.

body.notes: Ostermann REDOCOL pre-glued fluted dowel to DIN 68150: diameter tolerance +/- 0.2 mm, length +/- 1 mm, 20 lengthwise flutes, 60 degree chamfer, kiln-dried beech at 8 to 10% moisture (manufacturer datasheet, 1/2026).
